tools.name: search_offers
tools.description:
Search for active offers in the AnyGett database.

Returns a JSON array of matching offers with all fields parsed.
Returns an empty array if no offers match.

FILTERS (all optional):
- query: full-text search in title + description
- offer_type: "product" | "service" | "job" | "resume"
- category_id

tools.name: get_offer_details
tools.description:
Get complete details of a specific offer by its UUID.

Returns a single offer object with all fields (including contact_method, specific_attributes, geo_scope).
Returns an error object with code "NOT_FOUND" if the ID doesn't exist.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description:
List all available offer categories with their IDs, slugs, and icons.

Returns category records used as category_id when creating offers.
Each item includes: id, slug, name_en, icon, sort_order.

tools.name: create_offer
tools.description:
Create a new offer in the AnyGett database.

Requires a valid category_id from list_categories.

Returns: { status: "created", offer_id: "<uuid>", created_by: "<agent-identifier>" }

SPECIFIC ATTRIBUTES by offer_type:
- product: { condition: "new"|"used"|"refurbished", brand?, sku?, weight_kg?, ship

tools.name: update_offer
tools.description:
Partially update an existing offer by UUID.

Only the fields you provide are changed — omitted fields keep their current values.
Returns { status: "updated", offer_id: "<uuid>" } on success.
Returns error with code "NOT_FOUND" if the offer doesn't exist.

tools.description:
Permanently delete an offer by UUID.

WARNING: This action is irreversible. The offer will be removed from the database entirely.
Consider using update_offer with status: "archived" instead if you want to hide the offer without deleting it.
